rule: Red rectangles are erased to background. A red rectangle comes back only if it fits a comb slot, which means four things. (1) It slides cardinally, ignoring other red, for at least one step. (2) Its front face lands fully on a single comb. (3) The two cells flanking that front strip are not comb. (4) The landed cells lie inside that comb's bounding box. A fitting piece is restamped red against the stub, and every cell it swept, from its original cells to just behind its landing cells, becomes 0. All other red vanishes.
scope: Constructive cardinal sliding of rectangular red pieces into comb slots; exact front contact, endpoint width and bounding-box containment determine acceptance, and outputs explicitly paint swept zero trails. Includes fitting pieces and random/near-miss distractors.
constraints: All four canonical pairs reconstruct exactly.

Removing bounding-box containment changes 931 outputs; removing the endpoint-width rule changes 941 outputs, showing these checks are not dormant.

authored_scope: Random mode samples five groups of variables. (1) Grid size 14..30 per side; this is a synthetic extension of the 19x22 and 23x27 fixtures. (2) Background and ink drawn from {1,3..9}, distinct from each other. (3) 2-3 combs with any of 4 orientations, gaps 1-2, stub width 1-3 and leg length 3-4. (4) At least one stub-wide fitting piece, with depth 1..legs-1. It starts at or beyond the leg tips, or between the legs. (5) 2-9 distractors: random rectangles plus wide, narrow, shifted, leg-tip and overhang near misses. Explicit mode takes comb, piece and target latents and reconstructs all four canonical fixtures. It accepts 1+ combs whose boxes are separated, and checks the declared targets against the geometry. Two cases are deliberately not sampled at random: a stub-wide piece too deep for its slot, and red pieces lying in another piece's sliding path. Neither is shown by the fixtures.
authored_constraints: Comb bounding boxes are pairwise disjoint with a one-cell margin, so combs never touch or nest.
Pieces are full rectangles. They neither touch nor overlap any comb or any other piece, including diagonally.
Every targeted piece fits exactly one (direction, distance, comb), in its comb's opening direction. Every untargeted piece fits none.
Swept trails of fitting pieces are pairwise disjoint. In random mode they stay a cell away from other pieces and from other combs' boxes.
Background strictly outnumbers both ink and red cells in the input, so it is the recoverable dominant colour.
Colour 2 is reserved for pieces and 0 for trails. Background and ink are never 0 or 2, and never equal to each other.
Random scenes contain no stub-wide in-lane piece that is too deep to fit the slot.
